store_data.about_the_game:
⚠️ NO-HORROR MODE AVAILABLE

This game includes an optional mode where jump scares and psychological elements can be disabled, allowing you to play using only the card‑game mechanics.

In the Exiled Prison, scares remain active, as they are part of the core challenge.

Memo R.I.P. is a first‑person psychological horror card game for 1–4 players with real‑time voice. Every match blends strategy, tension, and dynamic scares. The game features 6 rooms, each containing 150 unique scares, for a total of 900 events that react to your Madness Bar. The higher it gets, the more vulnerable you become: you’ll see the entity that lives in the room, hear it, feel it, and fall for its distractions—forgetting your hand’s value and losing the match.

First‑person card gameplay

You play on cozy‑futuristic tables inside a spaceship, lit by stable or unstable neon depending on the room’s state. Each room has its own entity, its own behavior, and its own way of watching and manipulating you. You don’t know which one you’ll get. You don’t know which card will wake it up. You don’t know when it will move behind you.

Dynamic psychological horror

The Blackbell System alters the rules in real time. AI fills empty player slots. Vivox transmits your breathing, doubts, and reactions… but during Blackbell, you won’t hear your teammates—yet they will hear you. The six card‑game variants completely change the pace of each match.

The Exiled Prison

Winning a match is not the end. At certain levels, the trial of the Exiled Boss awaits: you wake up in the Exiled Prison, an explorable map inspired by PT, Visage, and Resident Evil. Find the Four Cards of Madness, solve puzzles, and survive the whispers trying to break your mind. Each victory progresses your 20‑level journey, unlocking new characters, deck designs, and card backs.

Progression and the Exiled Boss

Defeating the Exiled Boss unlocks a new map aboard the S.C. Defender, featuring reactive music, 150 unique scares, and a different entity. The cycle continues until level 20. You can defeat the Exiled Boss only five times to unlock the five hidden maps—each attempt harder than the last. Losing means returning to the table, winning a match, going back to the Prison, finding the four cards, and challenging the boss again for a new S.C. Defender room.

Menu → Lobby → Match (Victory) → Prison → Boss → New Map

Characters, cosmetics, and languages

The game includes 10 base characters, and through progression and cosmetics you can reach a total of 36 playable characters. With a Skull‑based economy and support for 44 languages, Memo R.I.P. blends psychological horror, strategy, and exploration into an experience that never repeats itself.

store_data.about_the_game:
A dark-fantasy RPG about breaking the boundary between worlds... and surviving what comes through.

Veilbreak is a story-driven JRPG where reality itself is beginning to fracture. Across the land, ancient seals are failing... and something from beyond is pushing its way in.

What begins as a desperate escape from a cult ritual quickly spirals into a world on the brink of invasion. Portals tear open without warning. Creatures not meant for this world slip through, And somewhere beyond the Veil... something far worse is waiting.

You’ll lead a party of unlikely heroes- each pulled into a conflict far bigger than themselves. As the fractures spread, so does the truth:

This isn’t just an invasion.

It’s a search.

And you are being hunted.

Travel across coastal cities, ancient spires, underground trenches, and forgotten ruins as you track the source of the breaches. From the vibrant streets of Azura Bay to the depths of corrupted temples, every region brings new threats... and new answers.

Face twisted guardians, Veil-touched monstrosities, and powerful entities slipping between worlds. Close the fractures. Survive the encounters, and uncover why the barrier between realms is breaking... and who-or what-is trying to tear it down completely.

store_data.about_the_game:
Bench Simulator is a narrative simulation game where you experience the world from the perspective of a park bench.

Across several in-game days, different people come to the park, sit on the bench, and leave behind pieces of their lives. Couples, strangers, lonely night visitors, suspicious characters, families, and emotionally troubled people all pass through the same quiet place. You cannot walk, speak, or directly control them — but your small reactions can influence what happens.

As the bench, you observe conversations, read emotional situations, and react through subtle interactions such as shaking, shifting, creaking, or staying completely still. A small movement at the right time may interrupt an argument, create an awkward silence, comfort someone, or change the direction of a conversation.

Bench Simulator is not about action or combat. It is about presence, memory, timing, and the quiet impact of being there.

Every visitor brings a different story. Some moments are funny, some are romantic, some are uncomfortable, and some are emotionally heavy. As days pass, certain characters may return, previous choices may matter, and the bench slowly becomes a silent witness to the changing lives around it.

Key Features

- Play as a park bench in a unique narrative simulation experience

- Observe and influence conversations through subtle physical reactions

- Meet different visitors across multiple in-game days

- Experience emotional, funny, romantic, mysterious, and melancholic stories

- Make small choices that can affect character relationships and outcomes

- Discover recurring character arcs and different story consequences

- Experience day, evening, and night encounters with changing atmosphere

- Minimal, story-focused gameplay built around dialogue and observation

- Multiple outcome variations based on how you react during key moments

You are not the hero.

You are not the villain.

You are the bench.

You cannot speak.

You cannot leave.

But you can remember.

store_data.about_the_game:
Backrooms: Case Violet

A missing girl. An endless nightmare. A detective who refuses to leave without her.

Story:

In 1982 detective Jackson Webb is sent to Investigate a missing persons report for Violet Blackthorne, a 19 year old run away, After retracing her last known location he is sent to an abandoned warehouse where after finding no trace of Violet noclips through the floor into a yellow office space that seems to go on forever.

Now faced with surviving and escaping his new predicament he finds traces of violet in these backrooms and is on a mission to bring himself and violet back home.

Gameplay:

Set in the multi levelled backrooms found in the wiki dot lore, you find yourself able to traverse multiple levels to find resources to survive, with a rare ability to noclip inside the backrooms transporting yourself into a private homebase for base building, item storage and a safe space to plan your next ventures into the depths of this infinite procedurally generated hellscape.

As a detective hell bent on bringing violet home you complete quests that lead you across all levels chasing any hint you can find about violets whereabouts, but be careful as you'll be battling and running away from all the entities hellbent on killing you first.

  • Survive procedurally generated backrooms while dealing with entities trying to kill you.

  • Juggle with your food, water and sanity while traversing different levels of backrooms lore.

  • Craft weapons and other tools to help aid in your survival.

  • Investigate clues that lead you to Violet.

store_data.about_the_game:
ABOUT THE GAME

The war ended an hour ago. The field is littered with bodies. Crows are already gathering. And you — just hungry teenagers from a nearby village trying to survive.

Welcome to Battlefield Rats — a cooperative medieval scavenger simulator where you and your friends loot fallen warriors, avoid dangers, and try to carry away as much treasure as possible without losing your life, sanity, or each other.

GAMEPLAY

Each nighttime raid is a tense mix of greed, fear, and chaos. Sneak across the battlefield, search knights’ and soldiers’ bodies, stuff your bags with armor, weapons, and coins. But remember: the more you carry, the slower you move, and every sound can attract unwanted attention.

Search fallen warriors for valuable loot, but be careful — not every body is truly dead.

Manage your fear: nervous characters drop items, scream, and can panic at the worst moments.

Avoid dangers: mounted patrols with torches, roaming deserters, packs of wild dogs, and something far worse stalk the field looking for scavengers like you.

Work as a team or betray your friends: share finds, cover each other’s escape, or abandon them to save yourself and your loot.

Return to the village alive: sell your haul, buy gear, feed your characters, and prepare for the next outing on even more dangerous fields.

KEY FEATURES

Co-op for 1-4 players with voice chat — coordinate, joke, or scream in terror together.

Unique characters with different abilities: a swift scout, skilled looter, strong carrier, or cautious observer.

Fear and nerves system: your characters respond to danger, and you’ll have to handle their panic.

Loot physics: items realistically clink, clang, and hamper movement — quietly hauling full armor won’t be easy.

Procedurally generated battlefields with varying dangers, weather, and combat types.

Meta-progression: develop your village, upgrade gear, unlock new fields, and complete special orders.

Unpredictable events: from comical (a crow steals your wallet) to horrifying (what you thought was a corpse suddenly grabs your leg).

WHO IS THIS GAME FOR

Battlefield Rats is made for groups of friends who love cooperative games with elements of horror and dark humor. If you enjoy Lethal Company, Content Warning, or Phasmophobia but want something with a historical setting and unique mechanics — this game is for you.

Get ready to laugh, scream, and betray your friends for a golden chain.

store_data.about_the_game:
CLICK YOURSELF INTO DAMNATION


Soul Clicker is an incremental clicker game about harvesting souls from the
depths of Hell. Start with a single click. End up running an infernal empire
that grinds out souls by the sextillion while you sleep.

Every soul you collect feeds a deeper, darker engine. Every prestige peels
back another layer. There is always a bigger number — and you will chase it.

WHAT YOU'LL DO


  • Click. A lot. Tap to earn souls. Buy buildings. Buy upgrades. Watch
    the numbers climb from 1 → 1,000 → 1 billion → 1 sextillion → and beyond.
  • Build an empire. 31 buildings across three tiers — base, advanced,
    and eternal. Each one produces souls automatically while you do other
    things. Stack them. Multiply them. Worship them.
  • Prestige. Forever. When you've climbed high enough, burn it all
    down for Prestige Points. Spend PP on 53 permanent upgrades across 8
    categories. Come back stronger. Climb faster. Burn it down again.
  • Master four realms. Each advanced building unlocks a minigame:
    • Chaos Engine — spend Chaos Orbs on a tree of building boosts
      and use them to buy Eternal Buildings outright.
    • Abyssal Drill — mine Ancient Fragments and roll for relics
      across five rarities and five effect types.
    • Soul Forge — gamble your souls. Win double or jackpot 10×.
      Lose them all.
    • Lust Labyrinth — hire workers who click for you while
      you're busy clicking for yourself.
  • Equip relics. Roll for randomized rarity-based gear. Stack
    Global CPS, Click power, cost reduction, and auto-clicks. Find the
    legendary All-Seeing Eye and watch every multiplier light up at once.
  • Chase 200+ achievements. Every one you unlock permanently
    boosts your soul production by 1%. By the time you've collected
    them all, idle income is nearly 4× stronger.

FEATURES


  • 31 buildings — from a single Tormented Soul to the Eternal Soul Nexus
  • 500+ building upgrades — each one a meaningful jump
  • 53 prestige upgrades across 8 themed categories
  • 4 fully-fleshed minigames tied to advanced buildings
  • 21 distinct relics across 5 rarities, with bulk inventory management
  • 200+ achievements — each one boosts CPS by 1%
  • 5 random events with massive temporary boosts
  • Custom soundtrack across three moods — pick Main, Lofi, or Metal
  • Independent SFX and BGM volume sliders
  • Save anywhere — local saves, plus export/import for backups
  • No microtransactions. No ads. No timers. No paywalls.

store_data.about_the_game:
An infinitely expanding 2D Psychological Horror clicker game with hundreds of secrets and puzzles to solve and explore. There is always more to see.

Work through the game's infinitely progressing storyline uncovering the secrets and scares hidden in the deep environmental story-telling.

You are tasked with destroying an ancient artifact all while fending off the entities it attracts and uncovering the meaning behind it all before it's too late.

Beat the game? Great!

With the infinitely expanding storyline in the 'chapter select' structure of the game, you can keep playing with new game mechanics, new lore to uncover, to horrifying monsters to see, and so much more.

Beat all the current content? That's fine.

With the implementation of multiple save files, you are encouraged to replay the game and see all the things you may have missed the first time around.

Important

The Discord server linked on the Steam Store page of the game is where indepth patch notes and development updates will be recorded. Please consider joining if you want to hear about and become a part of the development of the game.

The Discord server is not just a place for the game's community, it is a tool the players can use to enhance their experience while playing. Player's who join the discord have the opportunity to shape the game's future development and become immortalised in the game's credits forever just for making a suggestion.

So i urge you to please join our Discord community if you want to become a apart of something bigger.

This game is made by a solo developer, (me), and I am putting all of my effort and passion into this project, I will listen to every single bit of feedback given both on Steam and in the game's official Discord you can find on the store page.

Be a part of the game's development, let me know what you want to see.

store_data.about_the_game:
《Fluff Up》is a charming yet brutally precise platformer starring a bird who's carrying a few extra ounces. Your

mission: flap, climb, and drag that chunky little body into the sky. It's equal parts delightful and punishing.

GAMEPLAY

The controls couldn't be simpler — hold left or right and your bird flies in that direction. But flying burns stamina

fast, and if you run out before you reach the next cloud, gravity does what gravity does. Plan every move. You're not

exactly aerodynamic.

FEATURES

Easy to learn, hard to stop failing at. This bird is heavy — the physics won't let you forget it. Mid-air turns are

sluggish, stamina is never quite enough, and every flight demands a split-second plan before you commit. There's no

winging it.

Land soft, or fall straight through. Obviously. Clouds are fluffy; your bird is not. Control your descent or you'll

regret it.

Clouds are your friends — most of them, anyway. Every cloud type has its own personality. Learn their patterns, figure

out who helps and who betrays, and you'll climb faster. Or just blame the clouds. Up to you.

A slip isn't the end. If you tumble off a cloud, don't panic — you can still recover. Use whatever's below you to

cushion the fall, scramble for another perch, and claw your way back. Whether you bounce back or plummet to the bottom

depends entirely on your hands.

EXPERIENCE

Cheerful pixel art brings this whimsical world to life, while the tough-as-nails gameplay keeps you coming back for

one more try. The moment you finally break through the highest layer of clouds? Worth every fall.

But success can wait. If you're exhausted, just land on a cloud and rest for a bit. There's no game over here —

falling only means you start climbing again. Take your time. The sky isn't going anywhere.

store_data.about_the_game:
Crowned Games is an online party game platform for groups of 2–12 players.

One host, one lobby, many minigames — play them all in a single session.

YOUR CONTENT, YOUR RULES

Every game that uses player-provided content draws from your own packs.

Build a pack with photos from your friend group, inside jokes as words,

or custom audio clips — the games become personal.

Packs support four asset types:

• Images — use your own photos or downloaded art

• Audio — voice clips, sound effects, music snippets

• Words — custom word lists for drawing or clue games

• Prompts — custom questions and scenarios

📝 QUIZ EDITOR

Build your own trivia rounds from scratch. Write questions, set answer options,

mark the correct one. Import them as a pack and challenge your friends with

questions only they (or only you) would know.

🎮 THE GAMES

IMPOSTOR — Social deduction

Everyone gets the same secret word — except the Impostor. Give clues that prove

you know it without giving it away. Vote out the Impostor before they blend in.

STINKY CROWN — Voting

Each round, a prompt appears. Vote for who in the group fits it best.

The most-voted player earns the Stinky Crown. It stacks.

FRAMEUP — Bluffing

You get an image. Describe it to the group — but you choose whether to describe

yours truthfully or invent a lie about someone else's. The group votes: truth or lie?

MIRAGE — Hint & match

One player writes a hint for their image. Everyone else picks the image from their

own hand that best matches that hint. The group then votes for the original.

Hints that are too obvious or too cryptic lose points — balance is everything.

DOODLE KINGS — Draw & guess

Pick a secret word and draw it. Other players race to type the answer first.

Speed pays more than accuracy — fastest correct guess earns the most points.

QUIZ DUEL — Trivia

A question appears. First to buzz in gets to answer. Right answers earn points,

wrong answers give the lead to someone else. Use your own quiz packs or the defaults.

FEATURES

✓ Multiple minigames in one lobby — mix and match in any order

✓ 2–12 players online

✓ Custom image, audio, word, and prompt packs

✓ Built-in Quiz Editor — write your own trivia rounds

✓ Running score across all games in a session
